title: A Study to Determine the Safety and Efficacy of Atralin (Tretinoin 0.05%) Gel for the Treatment of Rosacea
brief_summary: To compare the efficacy and safety of tretinoin gel 0.05% to its vehicle when dosed once or twice daily in female subjects with rosacea.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Female
* Age 18-65
* Diagnosed with classical, centrofacial, erythemato-telangiectatic rosacea

Exclusion Criteria:

* Male, females less than 18 years
* Females over 65 years
* No diagnosed rosacea
